title: The Mézard–Parisi formula for diluted spin glasses

abstractEnglish: We prove the Mézard–Parisi hierarchical cavity formula for diluted even-arity Ising models in the Panchenko–Talagrand class. This resolves the variational equality conjecture for that class: the limiting pressure equals the infimum of the trial functional over all finite hierarchy depths and trial laws. Only first moments of the interaction and external field are required.
titleEn: The Mézard–Parisi formula for diluted spin glasses

details.overview: 稿件针对Panchenko–Talagrand类中的稀释偶数元Ising模型，证明Mézard–Parisi分层空腔公式。摘要表示这解决了该类的变分等式猜想：极限压强等于在所有有限层级深度和试验律上试验泛函的下确界，且仅需相互作用与外场的一阶矩。该结果若成立，将为稀释自旋玻璃的平均场理论提供严格数学基础。
keyPoints: 研究对象是Panchenko–Talagrand类中的稀释偶数元Ising模型。
作者声称证明Mézard–Parisi分层空腔公式并解决变分等式猜想。
结果仅要求相互作用和外场的一阶矩。
